precision: float32; TF32 disabled; no mixed precision

charged_components: hard UC decoding or direct threshold selection
budget.scheduler: At each target fraction, reserve the largest prior measured checkpoint cost; stop training at the first synchronized minibatch boundary reaching target minus reserve. The first checkpoint has zero reserve. All five checkpoint costs count toward the same candidate wall-clock budget. Early 2.5% and 10% checkpoints let fast baselines select before overfitting.
budget.invalid_budget_action: Complete and report descriptive outputs; prohibit confirmatory equal-compute inference when any candidate or system total lies outside the fixed 2% tolerance.

decisions.development_selection: mean per-case F1 on selective_non_singleton UC at n=12; hard systems use frozen P>.5 hard UC without a membership cutoff; direct systems optimize development absolute threshold
decisions.tie_break: earlier checkpoint, smaller lambda; for direct readout threshold nearest 0.5 then smaller threshold

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction of the two fixed primary contrasts
inference.secondary: descriptive only: common-hard auxiliary controls, all-class means, n=48, exact recovery, cardinality, edge fidelity, tie incidence; no additional confirmatory endpoints

sharding.unit: complete independent collection with all three paired initializations and all six systems
sharding.global_inference: exactly twelve unique collections required; never pool graphs, initializations, or shards as independent units
sharding.hardware: all production shards require the same GPU model, capability and pinned numerical environment
